notes.title: We plan to make "freudgate" free
notes.content:
Thank you for your support for "freudgate". The game has been released for more than two years. We have also changed from students to workers, unable to update the game next. Now we set the game free, hoping that more people can play it.
In February 2022, "freudgate" will change from charging to free. Thank you for your support, especially those who pass the customs.

notes.title: Thanks to all the players who support freudgate
notes.content:
According to the plan, in addition to the production cost and delivery cost of a small number of egg stalls, as well as the platform charge, the remaining 6934.98 yuan has been donated (as shown in the figure).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35952135/c3da0fe425ba6f75f66fc0f00134e00620e42553.png[/img]
data
At present, the praise rate of steam purchasers is 83% and that of all purchasers is 89%; 20.5% of them have completely passed the customs, 7% have found the "destroyer" eggs, and 48.5% have reached bad ending.
Follow-up
Overall, the results are satisfactory. Of course, half of our seven developers have graduated and worked, and the rest are busy taking part in postgraduate entrance examination or continuing their studies. After all, we still have to eat. We can't leave school or work to complete a bigger action. Unhappiness and joy in cooperation will become history. We cherish this time and the communication with players in the group. Since then, everyone has gone to different places, may cooperate, or may find a new team to continue to work miracles.
Thank
Finally, thank all the supporters, especially the 17.4% who understood our obscure game language and opened that door.

notes.title: First Update: Some Interaction Issues Are Fixed
notes.content:
19 issues reported by players or developers are fixed.

We will try our best to improve this game. 
Thanks.
